narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seventy two times a hundred twenty five is seventy two thousand, as it is about a thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A hundred twenty five is only an eighth of a thousand.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Seventy two thousand is eight times too big, so the slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with seventy two thousand; 125 and 1000 bars are compared; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Look for pairs that make a hundred or a thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Rewrite a hundred twenty five as a thousand divided by eight.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Then do the quick products first.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words pairs of 100 and 1000 appear; the words 125 = 1000 ÷ 8 appear; the words quick first appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip uses a hundred twenty five as a thousand and stops at seventy two thousand. A hundred twenty five is a thousand divided by eight.
